kind: isolated exploratory benchmark requested by the user; not production workflow; not M7
question: Compare Claude Haiku, Sonnet and Opus as authors of procedural Blender code for one educational brief, under a common component library, worker, QA and blind Opus review.

design.replicaIds: R1-R9, family assignment shuffled with secrets.SystemRandom; mapping kept in coordinator/mapping.json and never given to reviewers
design.authorContext: fresh Claude Code subagent (general-purpose) per replica; the same context authors blockout, detail and its own corrections via SendMessage continuation

models.resolution: Claude Code Agent tool aliases haiku/sonnet/opus resolved by runtime to claude-haiku-5-5 / claude-sonnet-5-5 / claude-opus-5-5; confirmed in probe transcripts (prefix.json model + message.model) on 2026-10-23; re-confirmed per agent in receipts
models.effortRationale: medium is supported by all three (low-max) and is the API default for Haiku 5.5 and Opus 5.5; Sonnet 5.5 defaults to high so it is set explicitly. Same nominal label; effort scales are not claimed equivalent across families.

coordinator.role: organizes, runs Blender sequentially, builds blind packets and relays reviewer text; writes no condition geometry

reviewer.context: fresh subagent per reviewed run, blind packet only

models.contamination: any response model different from the expected ID, a nested Agent, or forbidden reads per audit marks the attempt contaminated and outside the main comparison
models.noFallbacks: no opusplan, no model fallback, no coordinator-written geometry

controls.blender: 5.2.3 LTS (Windows native, invoked from WSL through creation-lab/benchmarks/claude-animal-cell/wsl-blender.sh)
controls.render: Cycles CPU, 2 threads, 24 samples, 768 px, six views

gates: technical (build/reopen/reimport, budgets, size on all axes, nondegenerate, GLB self-contained)
limits: n=3 per family: exploratory, no statistical ranking
measures component-assisted authoring, not generation from scratch
same-family reviewer bias possible for opus condition; reviewer is model-assisted, not an external teacher; human review NOT_RUN unless recorded
compares authors under one assisted review system; not end-to-end Haiku/Sonnet/Opus-only workflows
historical Sol/Luna/Astra pilot used no visual loop nor component library: context only, no cross-provider claims
token counts come from runtime transcripts; cost NOT_AVAILABLE; Blender time is not model latency
